       [n IN nodes(p) | CASE WHEN n:Valve THEN 'valve' WHEN n:Equipment THEN 'equipment' WHEN n:ProcessInstrumentationFunction THEN 'instrument' ELSE 'inline' END] AS types,
       [n IN nodes(p) | head([l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['BallValve','GlobeValve','CheckValve','CentrifugalPump','HeatExchanger','ProcessColumn','Tank','OperatedValve','ProcessInstrumentationFunction','ActuatingFunction','PipingComponent','UnresolvedOffPageConnector'] | l])] AS kinds

MATCH (d)
WHERE d.document_id = 'swagelok-ms-01-176'
  AND any(l IN labels(d) WHERE l IN ['plm__PCA_100029511','plm__PCA_100029508','plm__PCA_100029510','plm__PCA_100029505'])
  AND (toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521,'')) CONTAINS 'working pressure'
       OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521,'')) CONTAINS 'pressure rating'
       OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521,'')) CONTAINS 'maximum back pressure'
